title: cobalt insight: cost model inputs
about: Every price, limit and assumption the insight cost model uses (apple/PROPOSAL-INSIGHT.md). Each entry has value, unit, source_url, read_on and confidence. confidence 'verified' = read from the source_url on read_on; 'estimated' = a guess, an inference, or a number the page read did not state. A page can compute every figure in the proposal from `production`, `prices`, `limits`, `assumptions` and `options` with the formulas in `formulas`; `computed` is that arithmetic run once (scratch script, 2026-10-10) so a page can check itself. How pages were read: platform.claude.com pricing and batch rows from the raw page text; developers.cloudflare.com pages through a fetch tool that summarises with a small model (three prices cross-checked by neuron arithmetic), so open a source_url before money depends on one figure.

production.source: D1 cobalt-keys (media_items, studio_sessions), read by the owner's session on 2026-10-10 and passed to this lane; not re-queried here
production.note: 162 videos + 25 stills + 4 galleries is 191 things to describe against 172 posts: the counts are files, and a few posts hold more than one. The model prices 191 describes, an upper bound on 172 posts.

haiku55_input.unit: USD per million input tokens, prompts up to 100,000 tokens

haiku55_output.unit: USD per million output tokens, prompts up to 100,000 tokens (thinking tokens bill as output)

haiku55_cache_write_5m.unit: USD per million tokens written to the 5 minute cache

haiku55_cache_write_1h.unit: USD per million tokens written to the 1 hour cache

haiku55_cache_read.unit: USD per million cached tokens read

haiku55_long_input.unit: USD per million input tokens when the prompt is over 100,000 tokens (5x)

haiku55_long_output.unit: USD per million output tokens when the prompt is over 100,000 tokens (5x)

haiku55_batch_input.unit: USD per million input tokens, Message Batches API

haiku55_batch_output.unit: USD per million output tokens, Message Batches API

anthropic_batch_discount.unit: fraction off every token price; stacks with the cache multipliers

anthropic_us_only_multiplier.unit: x on every token price with inference_geo: "us" (not used; global is the default)

workers_ai_free_neurons_per_day.unit: neurons per day, free, on Workers Free and Workers Paid

whisper_base_per_minute.unit: USD per audio minute, @cf/openai/whisper (41.14 neurons; not chosen)

nova3_per_minute.unit: USD per audio minute, deepgram nova-3 on Workers AI (not chosen: 10x whisper)

gemma4_input.unit: USD per million input tokens, @cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (9,091 neurons)

gemma4_output.unit: USD per million output tokens, @cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (27,273 neurons)

llama32_vision_input.unit: USD per million input tokens, llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct (alternative)

llama32_vision_output.unit: USD per million output tokens, llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct (alternative)

mistral_small31_input.unit: USD per million input tokens, mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct (alternative)

mistral_small31_output.unit: USD per million output tokens, mistral-small-3.1-24b-instruct (alternative)

bge_m3.unit: USD per million input tokens, @cf/baai/bge-m3 (1,075 neurons; the model page says $0.0118)

embeddinggemma_300m.unit: no price listed on its model page or the pricing page; marked Beta (not chosen)

ai_gateway_core.unit: USD; analytics, caching and rate limiting are free

ai_gateway_unified_billing_fee.unit: fraction added to credits bought (USD 100 of credit costs USD 105); provider tokens pass through with no markup. Not used: the plan is the owner's own Anthropic key

vectorize_queried_dims_included.unit: queried vector dimensions per month included on Workers Paid

vectorize_stored_dims_included.unit: stored vector dimensions included on Workers Paid

vectorize_queried_dims.unit: USD per million queried dimensions past the included amount; queried dimensions in a month = (stored vectors + queries) x dimensions

vectorize_stored_dims.unit: USD per 100 million stored dimensions past the included amount

container_memory.unit: USD per GiB-second, provisioned; 25 GiB-hours a month included

container_cpu.unit: USD per vCPU-second, active use; 375 vCPU-minutes a month included

container_disk.unit: USD per GB-second, provisioned; 200 GB-hours a month included

media_transformations_op.unit: USD per operation (USD 0.50 per 1,000) past 5,000 free a month, shared with Image Transformations; a still frame is 1 operation, audio or video output is 1 operation per second of output. The Workers binding is in open beta and not billed during it; afterwards billed per operation (no monthly dedupe). The alternative way to cut frames, not the plan

workflows_requests_included.unit: requests a month included, then USD 0.30 per million

workflows_cpu_ms_included.unit: CPU ms a month included, then USD 0.02 per million; waiting on a fetch or a sleep bills no CPU

workflows_steps_included.unit: steps a month included, then USD 0.80 per 100,000 (retries not counted)

workflows_storage_included_gb.unit: GB-month included, then USD 0.20 per GB-month

queues_ops_included.unit: operations a month included, then USD 0.40 per million; a delivered message is 3 operations (not used by the plan)

durable_objects_requests_included.unit: requests a month included, then USD 0.15 per million (an alarm is a request)

durable_objects_duration_included.unit: GB-seconds a month included, then USD 12.50 per million (128 MB per object while awake)

r2_storage.unit: USD per GB-month, Standard; 10 GB-month free

r2_class_a.unit: USD per million writes/lists; 1 million a month free

r2_class_b.unit: USD per million reads; 10 million a month free

d1_rows_written.unit: USD per million rows written past 50 million a month included

d1_rows_read.unit: USD per million rows read past 25 billion a month included

workers_paid_base.unit: USD a month, already paid by this deployment (Containers and Durable Objects need it); 10 million requests and 30 million CPU ms included

ai_search_billing_starts.unit: date AI Search billing begins; 5 million ingestion tokens, 1,000 semantic queries and 10 GB-month included a month (not used by the plan)

claude_video_input.unit: Claude takes text and images, not video or audio: a video is sent as frames plus a transcript

claude_image_formats.unit: accepted image types; an animation is read as its first frame only

claude_image_patch_px.unit: pixels; an image costs ceil(width/28) x ceil(height/28) visual tokens

claude_image_max_long_edge_px.unit: pixels; larger images are downscaled first. The page says 'Claude 4.7 and later models'; that Haiku 5.5 is in that tier is read from that wording, not from a Haiku 5.5 row

claude_image_max_visual_tokens.unit: visual tokens per image at most, high-resolution tier

claude_images_per_request.unit: images per API request for models whose context is not 200k (Haiku 5.5 is 1M)

claude_many_image_threshold.unit: images; above this every image in the request must be at most 2000 px on each side or the request is refused

claude_image_max_bytes_base64.unit: bytes per image, base64-encoded, on the Claude API

haiku55_long_context_threshold.unit: prompt tokens (cache reads and writes count); over it the whole request pays 5x

haiku55_default_effort.unit: output_config.effort default; thinking is adaptive and on by default

haiku55_thinking_can_be_disabled.unit: thinking: {type: "disabled"} is accepted at effort high or below. Source is the claude-api skill bundled with Claude Code (cached 2026-10-06), not a page fetched on read_on

claude_tokenizer_inflation.unit: x; Claude 4.7 and later count the same text as about 30% more tokens than older models

claude_cache_min_tokens.unit: tokens; a shorter cached prefix silently does not cache (Haiku 5.5)

claude_structured_outputs_haiku55.unit: output_config.format json_schema is supported on claude-haiku-5-5; no maxItems, minLength or numeric bounds; at most 24 optional fields and 16 union-typed fields

anthropic_batch_max_requests.unit: requests per batch (or 256 MB, whichever first)

anthropic_batch_max_hours.unit: hours before an unfinished batch expires; most finish in under 1 hour

anthropic_batch_retention_days.unit: days requests and results are stored; the Batch API is not eligible for zero data retention

anthropic_batch_cache_hit_range.unit: fraction; cache hits inside a batch are best effort

anthropic_default_retention_days.unit: days; API inputs and outputs are deleted within 30 days unless flagged (up to 2 years) or under a zero-data-retention agreement

anthropic_zdr_self_serve.unit: zero data retention is arranged per organization through Anthropic sales; there is no switch a self-serve account can flip

anthropic_rate_limit_start_tier_rpm.unit: requests a minute for Haiku 5.5 on the Start tier (2,000,000 input tokens and 400,000 output tokens a minute): never the bottleneck here

workers_ai_hosts_claude.unit: no Anthropic model is hosted on Workers AI; the Workers AI model list has none

cloudflare_catalog_has_haiku55.unit: Cloudflare's AI model catalog lists 12 third-party Anthropic models (anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 among them) and not Haiku 5.5, so unified billing and Cloudflare-side zero data retention cannot be assumed for it yet

ai_gateway_anthropic_endpoint.unit: base URL for the Anthropic SDK; only /v1/messages is documented, so the Batch and Files endpoints through the gateway are unconfirmed

ai_gateway_log_payload_header.unit: request header: keep the log's metadata (tokens, cost, status) and store no prompt or response

ai_gateway_zdr_scope.unit: Cloudflare's zero-data-retention routing applies to unified-billing requests with Cloudflare-managed credentials, not to a request carrying the owner's own key

workers_ai_image_embedding_model.unit: no CLIP, SigLIP or other image-embedding model on Workers AI (only resnet-50 classification)

gemma4_context.unit: tokens; vision listed as supported, how images are passed and counted is not on the page

bge_m3_context.unit: tokens per input on Workers AI

bge_m3_dimensions.unit: dimensions per vector; from the model's own card, the Cloudflare page read did not state it. Confirm with one call before creating the index (an index's dimensions cannot be changed)

vectorize_id_max_bytes.unit: bytes per vector id (a post key can be a long link, so ids are minted, never the key)

vectorize_metadata_indexes.unit: filterable metadata properties per index; a string is indexed by its first 64 bytes; created before vectors are inserted

vectorize_topk_with_metadata.unit: results per query with values or metadata (100 without)

media_transformations_input_max_bytes.unit: bytes of source video (and 10 minutes); a saved original here may be up to 200 MB (MAX_SOURCE_BYTES, deploy/cloudflare/api/src/studio.ts:83). Audio output is at most 60 s per call

media_binding_private_r2.unit: env.MEDIA.input(<R2 object body>).output({mode: "frame", time, format: "jpg"}) works on a private bucket's stream; public open beta

workflows_step_return_max_bytes.unit: bytes a step may return (frames therefore live in R2, steps pass keys)

workflows_max_steps.unit: steps per instance on Workers Paid (default)

workflows_state_retention_days.unit: days a finished instance's state is kept on Workers Paid

agents_sdk_base.unit: the Agents SDK's Agent class is a Durable Object with SQL state, schedule(), queue(), fibers and WebSockets; npm package `agents`

cf_config_bindings.unit: binding helpers present in the repo's installed deploy tool (cf 1.0.0-beta.5, @cloudflare/config 0.20.0): deploy/cloudflare/api/node_modules/@cloudflare/config/dist/public-DA8eKvPJ.d.mts lines 108, 260, 288, 1585. Present in the types; not deployed

helper_sweep_gap_seconds.unit: seconds between sweep passes (SWEEP_DELAY_S, deploy/cloudflare/api/src/sweep.ts:20); one helper job starts per pass

helper_sleep_after_seconds.unit: seconds the container stays up after its last call (deploy/cloudflare/api/src/index.ts:37)

frame_long_edge_px.unit: pixels, longer side of a sampled video frame (never upscaled)

frame_aspect.unit: width:height assumed for the token estimate (130 of 170 sources are instagram; the real mix of shapes was not measured). 9:16 at 768 is 432x768 = 16 x 28 = 448 tokens; a square frame is 784

frame_label_tokens.unit: tokens of text before each frame ('frame 3 at 0:12')

photo_long_edge_px.unit: pixels, longer side of a still photo sent for describing; 3:4 assumed (768x1024 = 28 x 37 = 1,036 tokens)

prompt_overhead_tokens.unit: tokens per request for the instructions, the facet lists and the JSON schema the API injects. Not measured: count it with messages.countTokens once the prompt exists

post_context_tokens.unit: tokens per request for the link, service, file name, duration and size

speech_share.unit: fraction of video seconds that carry words Whisper returns (many clips are music only). Not measured

transcript_tokens_per_second.unit: tokens per second of speech (about 150 words a minute, 1.3 tokens a word, x1.3 for the newer tokenizer)

output_tokens_base.unit: output tokens for one description document (title, description, tags, facets, on-screen text, entities, search phrases)

output_tokens_per_scene.unit: output tokens per scene caption (haiku + scenes only)

scenes_per_frame.unit: scenes the model reports per frame it is shown (haiku + scenes only)

thinking_tokens.unit: output tokens of thinking per request; 0 = thinking disabled. With adaptive thinking at low effort budget a few hundred

workers_ai_image_tokens.unit: input tokens one image costs on the Workers AI vision model. The model page does not say; this is a guess

embed_tokens_card.unit: tokens embedded for a post's card text

said_tokens_cap.unit: tokens of transcript embedded at most as the post's 'said' vector

helper_seconds_base.unit: seconds the helper is held per describe before any frame: carrying the original in from R2, the probe, cleanup. Not measured

helper_seconds_per_frame.unit: seconds of ffmpeg per sampled frame on the basic instance. From the README's 'a second or two of ffmpeg' for one poster; not measured for a run of seeks

helper_seconds_per_media_second.unit: seconds of ffmpeg per second of video to cut the audio track to 16 kHz mono. Not measured

describer_idle_seconds.unit: seconds the describer's own container instance stays billed around one everyday describe besides the ffmpeg itself (cold start plus a 15 s sleep-after). Counted once per post in the monthly figures, not in the backfill, where jobs run back to back. Not measured

container_cpu_busy_share.unit: fraction of the basic instance's quarter vCPU counted as active while the helper is held (an upper bound)

frame_jpeg_bytes.unit: bytes per kept frame at 768 px, JPEG q4 (posters at 720 px measure 14 to 17 KB on test clips; real footage is busier)

cache_hit_rate_backfill.unit: fraction of backfill requests that read the cached instructions (requests run back to back inside the 5 minute window)

cache_hit_rate_steady.unit: fraction of everyday requests that read the cache (17 saves a day are rarely within 5 minutes of each other)

searches_per_month.unit: searches by meaning a month (20 a day); each embeds about 12 tokens and makes one Vectorize query

formulas.frames: frames(d) = min(max, max(min, ceil(d / every_seconds))) for a video of d seconds; a photo is 1 frame; a gallery is its photos.
formulas.frames_bucket: For a bucket of n videos totalling S seconds (per-video lengths are not in this file): n x min(max, max(min, S/n/every_seconds + 0.5)). The + 0.5 stands in for the ceiling. Exact where every video hits min or max (the under-15 s and 3-min-plus buckets); an upper bound for the 1 to 3 min bucket.
formulas.claude_image_tokens: ceil(w / 28) x ceil(h / 28), with (w, h) the frame scaled so its longer side is frame_long_edge_px.
formulas.input_tokens: prompt_overhead_tokens + post_context_tokens + frames x (image_tokens + frame_label_tokens) + speech_share x transcript_tokens_per_second x d
formulas.output_tokens: output_tokens_base + thinking_tokens + (scenes ? frames x scenes_per_frame x output_tokens_per_scene : 0)
formulas.describe_usd: input_tokens x input_price / 1e6 + output_tokens x output_price / 1e6
formulas.describe_usd_cached: as describe_usd, with prompt_overhead_tokens priced at hit x cache_read + (1 - hit) x cache_write_5m instead of the input price
formulas.whisper_usd: d / 60 x whisper_turbo_per_minute (videos with an audio track; list price, before the 10,000 free neurons a day)
formulas.embed_usd: (embed_tokens_card + min(said_tokens_cap, transcript tokens) + (scenes ? frames x scenes_per_frame x embed_tokens_scene : 0)) x bge_m3 / 1e6
formulas.helper_seconds: helper_seconds_base + frames x helper_seconds_per_frame + d x helper_seconds_per_media_second
formulas.container_usd: helper_seconds x (container_basic_vcpu x container_cpu_busy_share x container_cpu + container_basic_memory_gib x container_memory + container_basic_disk_gb x container_disk); list price, before the included monthly amounts
formulas.backfill_wall_clock_seconds: sum of helper_seconds over every describe + helper_sweep_gap_seconds x number of describes (one job starts per sweep pass, and only while the line is empty)
formulas.out_of_pocket: What is expected on a bill: the Anthropic tokens (describe_usd, haiku pipelines) plus Workers AI neurons past 10,000 a day; container seconds, Vectorize, Workflows, R2 and D1 sit inside what Workers Paid already includes at this size (not checked against the account's current usage).
formulas.vectorize_usd: max(0, (stored_vectors + queries) x dims - vectorize_queried_dims_included) x 0.01 / 1e6 + max(0, stored_vectors x dims - vectorize_stored_dims_included) x 0.05 / 1e8
formulas.monthly_usd: saves_per_day x days_per_month x (backfill total / posts_ready + describer_idle_seconds x container rate per second): a new save is priced as the average post of today's library (172 posts)

computed.by: scratch script run 2026-10-10 over this file; see apple/PROPOSAL-INSIGHT.md section 9 for the arithmetic shown bucket by bucket
